title: keraselma rubrum
intro: Keraselma rubrum, commonly known as Red Alga or Irish Moss, is a type of marine algae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Keraselma rubrum include soothing irritated tissues, reducing inflammation, and supporting digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carrageenan, fucoidan, and other polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
